fees.fee_manager_note: FeeManager contract governing this vault's fees.
fees.ipor_dao_fee_recipient_note: Address receiving the IPOR DAO's share of the performance and management fees.
fees.deposit_fee_percent_note: Onboarding Contribution: charged when a deposit is made into the vault, in shares rather than assets. null when not known - most often because this vault's FeeManager predates the deposit fee.
fees.request_fee_percent_note: Offboarding Contribution for Scheduled Withdrawals: charged at request time. Applies only to the Scheduled Withdrawal path, never to an Instant Withdrawal – a user pays one path, never both.
fees.withdraw_fee_percent_note: Offboarding Contribution for Instant Withdrawals: charged when performing an instant withdrawal. Applies only to the Instant Withdrawal path, never to a scheduled withdrawal request – a user pays one path, never both.
fees.performance_fee_percent_note: Performance Fee the vault actually charges, on share-price gains above the high-water mark (marked to market, so unrealized gains count).
fees.performance_fee_manager_percent_note: The same fee as recorded by the FeeManager. Expected to equal performance_fee_percent; a mismatch means the vault and its FeeManager have drifted out of sync.
fees.performance_fee_recipients_note: Named recipients of the performance fee and their shares. Excludes the IPOR DAO, whose share is the remainder up to performance_fee_manager_percent.
fees.high_water_mark_note: The performance fee applies only to gains above this exchange rate: the assets one whole share converts to, in underlying-asset units scaled by 10**asset_decimals. null when not known - most often because this vault's FeeManager predates high-water-mark support.
fees.management_fee_percent_note: Management Fee the vault actually charges, annualized on total assets.
fees.management_fee_manager_percent_note: The same fee as recorded by the FeeManager. Expected to equal management_fee_percent; a mismatch means the vault and its FeeManager have drifted out of sync.
fees.management_fee_recipients_note: Named recipients of the management fee and their shares. Excludes the IPOR DAO, whose share is the remainder up to management_fee_manager_percent.
fees.management_fee_last_update_timestamp_not: Unix timestamp of the last management-fee accrual update; 0 if never accrued.
fees.unrealized_management_fee_note: Management fee accrued but not yet collected, in underlying asset units. NOT deducted from total_assets, which is gross of fees per ERC-4626; subtract this to get net assets.

withdraw_manager_details.withdraw_window_seconds_note: Length of the window, starting at request time, in which a scheduled withdrawal can be executed (also requires the vault Alpha to release funds after the request).
withdraw_manager_details.fees_note: The two Offboarding Contributions (for Scheduled and for Instant Withdrawals) are reported in the top-level `fees` object, not here.
withdraw_manager_details.shares_to_release_note: Current shares the vault Alpha has approved for release via releaseFunds().
withdraw_manager_details.last_release_funds_timestamp_note: Release timestamp set by the last releaseFunds() call; 0 if never released.
withdraw_manager_details.total_pending_shares_note: Sum of shares across all pending withdrawal requests.
